validation_verification_boundaries: Verification-grade language requires explicit hardening evidence or a stated verification route.
The report must not imply field validation when only public-data analysis exists.
escalation_boundaries: No claim upgrade is allowed without identifying the verification work required.
reporting_constraints: If a claim needs hardening, the report must state the hardening path rather than hiding the limitation.
forbidden_output_families: Compliance closure, validated savings, and certified performance claims are forbidden unless hardening is complete.
